meta.name: Quarry 720p
meta.description: The story of Mac Conway, a Marine who returns home to Memphis from Vietnam in 1972 and finds himself shunned by those he loves and demonized by the public. As he struggles to cope with his experiences at war, Conway is drawn into a network of killing and corruption that spans the length of the Mississippi River.

videos.title: You Don't Miss Your Water
videos.overview: Sullied Vietnam vet Mac Conway is tempted by criminal elements after returning home to Memphis in 1972.

videos.title: Figure Four
videos.overview: Mac looks to pay down a debt. Joni is queried by detectives following the death of a co-worker.

videos.title: A Mouthful of Splinters
videos.overview: Mac is forced to turn to The Broker for help. Moses gets a new assignment.

videos.title: Seldom Realized
videos.overview: With Suggs at large, Mac and Joni are forced to seek temporary refuge in a remote hotel.

videos.title: Coffee Blues
videos.overview: An unspeakable act of racial violence rocks Memphis and the Solomon family.

videos.title: His Deeds Were Scattered
videos.overview: Mac gets a high-profile assignment from The Broker. A curfew is ordered in the wake of racial unrest.

videos.title: Carnival of Souls
videos.overview: The Broker enlists Mac to take down a top drug dealer. Olsen follows up on his suspicions.

videos.title: Nuoc Chay Da Mon
videos.overview: Mac confronts his war demons and settles a score with an old adversary.
